recipes.name: The Easiest Corn Pone with Bacon & Honey (3 Ingredients)
ingredients: ½ lb (226g) applewood bacon, fat reserved for cooking
instructions: In a large bowl, mix cornmeal, salt and hot water with a spoon. Let it rest until all the liquid is absorbed and a thick dough is formed, about 15-20 minutes.
Add the bacon to a large cast iron pan on medium heat and cook, flipping each piece until ¼-½ cup of bacon fat is rendered out - about 8-12 minutes.
Turn off the heat, drain the bacon on a paper towel-lined plate and chop for garnish. Leave the bacon fat in your pan while you form your corn patties.
To make your corn patties, use your hands to divide the dough into 6 portions, and flatten each portion to ¼-inch thick rounds. Optionally, use a ring mold instead if you have it.
Over medium heat, bring your bacon fat back to temp and fry the corn patties on one side until golden brown, about 4 minutes. Flip each patty and cook until golden brown, another 3-4 minutes.
Drain the corn patties on a wire rack over a paper towel-lined sheet tray, and season with salt immediately. Before serving, top with chopped bacon and drizzle with honey. Serve and enjoy.
